d: Launched in Bahrain in November of 2019, Calo is on a mission to make healthy easy. We’re a team of dedicated people driving this mission by providing better, faster, and cheaper ways to access food through technology.

We are looking for a Commis Chef to join our Calo team. The Commis Chef will support the kitchen team with basic food preparation and daily kitchen operations while maintaining Calo’s hygiene, safety, and quality standards.

The successful candidate will assist with tasks such as chopping, slicing, portioning, cleaning, ingredient handling, and supporting chefs, stewards, and kitchen helpers to ensure smooth kitchen operations. This role is ideal for someone eager to grow within a fast-paced kitchen environment and gain hands-on culinary experience.
For this role, we are seeking candidates with experience in hospitality, restaurants, central kitchens, or food production environments.
Works under the guidance of senior chefs, CDPs, and kitchen supervisors
Supports kitchen operations alongside stewards, kitchen helpers, and production staff
Works closely with Kitchen Management and Production Leads to maintain workflow efficiency
Shift-based work in temperature-controlled environments with mandatory personal protective equipment during all production operation times
Assist with basic food preparation including chopping, slicing, peeling, trimming, and portioning ingredients
Support chefs with mise en place and ingredient preparation as per standardized recipes
Assist with receiving, storing, labeling, and rotating ingredients following FIFO practices
Help maintain cleanliness and organization of kitchen stations, storage areas, and preparation areas
Support stewards and kitchen helpers with cleaning duties and maintaining sanitation standards
Ensure preparation tasks are completed efficiently and on time to support production and dispatch operations
Follow food safety, hygiene, and HACCP standards at all times
Assist in minimizing waste through proper handling and storage of ingredients
Support the kitchen team during busy operational periods and maintain teamwork across all sections
Carry out any additional kitchen support duties assigned by senior chefs or supervisors
Previous experience in restaurants, hotels, catering, central kitchens, or food production environments preferred
Basic understanding of food hygiene and kitchen safety standards
HACCP knowledge or certification is an advantage
Basic understanding of kitchen operations and food preparation techniques
Ability to work in a fast-paced and high-volume kitchen environment
Ability to follow instructions and work well within a team
Positive attitude and willingness to learn
Team player with good work ethic
Passion for food preparation and kitchen operations
Ability to maintain cleanliness, organization, and discipline in the kitchen
Committed to supporting the team and delivering quality standards consistently

d: Sealy Middle East manufactures premium mattresses, bed bases and sleep products, all made to order in its own factory in Jeddah. Products reach customers through showrooms across Saudi Arabia, the sealyme.com online store, dealers and B2B projects.

The Logistics Supervisor makes sure every mattress reaches showrooms, dealers and customers on time and undamaged, at the lowest reasonable cost. The role runs the daily delivery operation and leads the drivers, delivery crews and dispatch team.
q: Bachelor's degree in logistics, supply chain management, business administration or a related field.
At least 10 years of experience in logistics, transport or distribution, including supervisory experience leading drivers and delivery teams.
Nationality: Saudi, Yemeni, Indian or Pakistani.
Must currently reside in Jeddah, Saudi Arabia.
Strong knowledge of Saudi roads, cities and transport regulations.
Hands-on experience with an ERP system; Odoo experience is an advantage.
Good working knowledge of Microsoft Excel and Outlook.
Clear written and spoken English; Arabic is an advantage.
Strong leadership, problem-solving and time-management skills.
Experience in manufacturing, furniture or bulky-goods delivery is an advantage.
Delivery notes recorded in Odoo on the same day
Follow company policies, the code of conduct, and health and safety rules.
Keep customer, company and pricing information confidential.
Carry out any other related duties assigned by the direct manager.
r: Plan daily delivery routes and schedules from orders booked by Customer Service and Online Sales.
Supervise truck loading, check that goods match the delivery note, and verify paperwork before dispatch.
Lead, schedule and train drivers, delivery crews and dispatch staff, including attendance and performance follow-up.
Manage the delivery fleet: vehicle availability, fuel use, preventive maintenance, registrations and insurance renewals.
Select and manage third-party transport companies for long-distance, inter-city and export loads.
Collect signed delivery notes and record every delivery accurately in Odoo.
Coordinate daily with Production, the Warehouse, Customer Service and Online Sales so that dispatch follows confirmed stock and approved delivery schedules.
Track late deliveries, damages and customer delivery complaints, find the root causes and put corrective actions in place.
Control delivery costs and propose route, load and carrier improvements.
Enforce health and safety rules for loading, handling and driving, and keep vehicles and crews compliant with Saudi transport regulations.
Prepare regular logistics reports for the Supply Chain Supervisor.

d: Coordinate daily site logistics to ensure the safe and timely movement, delivery, storage, and distribution of materials, equipment, and supplies. Support construction activities by maintaining organized site access, efficient logistics arrangements, and close coordination with suppliers, subcontractors, and the project team.
q: Minimum 7 years of site logistics experience in high rise building construction.
UAE construction experience preferred; experience with high-rise projects and restricted urban sites is an advantage.
Practical knowledge of construction materials, delivery scheduling, storage requirements, and material handling equipment.
Familiarity with site traffic management, lifting coordination, and construction safety procedures.
Proficiency in Microsoft Excel, Outlook, and logistics tracking systems.
Good written and spoken English; Arabic and Hindi are an advantage.
r: Implement and maintain the site logistics plan, including access routes, delivery areas, unloading zones, storage areas, and waste collection points.
Prepare daily and weekly logistics schedules in coordination with construction teams and subcontractors.
Adjust logistics arrangements as construction progresses and site requirements change.
Identify access constraints, delivery conflicts, and storage limitations, and escalate issues with proposed solutions.
Schedule and coordinate deliveries with procurement, suppliers, transporters, and subcontractors according to project priorities.
Arrange delivery slots, gate access, unloading resources, and designated storage locations.
Coordinate cranes, hoists, forklifts, and other handling equipment with authorized operators and responsible supervisors.
Coordinate material distribution to work areas to minimize delays, congestion, damage, and unnecessary handling.
Track delayed, rejected, or incomplete deliveries and follow up with the relevant parties.
Coordinate vehicle and personnel access arrangements with site security and administration.Maintain clear access routes, pedestrian walkways, emergency exits, and firefighting access.
Coordinate vehicle movements with designated traffic marshals and banksmen.
Monitor compliance with approved delivery timings, parking arrangements, and site traffic rules.
Work with the Storekeeper to verify delivery documentation, quantities, visible condition, and storage allocation.
Coordinate required inspections with the QA/QC team before materials are released for use.
Ensure materials are stored securely and protected against damage, weather exposure, and obstruction.
Coordinate material transfers, returns, surplus materials, and removal of unused equipment.
Maintain logistics records and support stock reconciliation without duplicating the Storekeeper’s inventory responsibilities.
Coordinate lifting and unloading activities with the appointed lifting team and ensure required approvals are in place.
Report unsafe conditions, damaged handling equipment, blocked access routes, and logistics-related incidents promptly.
Coordinate waste segregation, skip placement, and timely waste collection with approved service providers.
Support housekeeping across delivery areas, storage zones, and internal access routes.
Attend site coordination meetings and communicate upcoming deliveries, resource needs, and logistics constraints.
Maintain delivery schedules, vehicle movement logs, equipment allocation records, and material transfer documentation.
Monitor vehicle turnaround times, equipment utilization, and avoidable waiting charges.
Support site mobilization and demobilization, including temporary facilities and equipment movements.
Provide regular updates to the Construction Manager on logistics performance and outstanding issues.
